name: Statement of Truth
title: Statement of Truth
text: I state that the contents of the paragraphs above are true to my own knowledge, save as to those matters stated on information received, which I believe to be true, and the source of which I have given. No part of this affidavit is false and nothing material has been concealed from it.

legal_basis.note: Affidavits confined to facts provable of the deponent's own knowledge

statutory_reference: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 - Order VI Rule 15, Order XIX Rule 3
authoring_note: An affidavit without a statement of truth in this form is a letter. The distinction between knowledge and belief is not a formality: it decides what weight the affidavit carries, and a blanket assertion that everything is true to knowledge, where plainly some of it cannot be, damages the deponent's credibility on all of it.
